title: Powers as Fibonacci Sums
summary: We examine the equation $y^{a}=\sum\limits_{i=1}^{k}F_{n_{i}}$ for positive integers $y,a\geq 2$ and $k\geq3$. This equation can be expressed as a problem in terms of the Zeckendorf representations of integers. Using bounds on linear forms in logarithms and Baker-Davenport reduction methods, we are able to completely solve the equation for $ y\leq 25000$ when $k=3$, for $y\leq 1000$ when $k= 4$, for $y\leq 40$ when $k= 5$, and for $y\leq 3$ when $k=6$.
